title: Histology Multi-Instance Learning Pipeline Parameters
description: Schema for Histology Multi-Instance Learning Pipeline parameters

input_output_options.title: Input/Output Options
input_output_options.description: Define the input data and output locations

dataset.description: Path to CSV file containing dataset with case_id, slide_id, and target columns
dataset.help_text: CSV file with at least: a case_id column to identify cases (patients) for case-level splitting, a slide_id column to link samples with feature files, and a target column (specified by params.target).
dataset.errorMessage: The dataset file path must end with .csv, must not contain spaces, and must exist.

features_dir.description: Base directory path where feature directories are located
features_dir.help_text: Base directory path used to construct feature paths. Feature directories follow the pattern: {features_dir}{mag}x_{patch_size}px_{overlap}px_overlap/features_{patch_encoder}/
features_dir.errorMessage: The features directory path must be at least 1 character long.

outdir.help_text: Directory where all pipeline outputs will be saved. Results include training results (summary.csv, test_results), predictions, splits, and plots (boxplot.png).
outdir.errorMessage: The output directory path must be at least 1 character long.

ml_options.title: Machine Learning Options
ml_options.description: Define the machine learning task configuration

target.description: Column name of the target variable to predict
target.help_text: Name of the column in the dataset CSV that contains the target variable (e.g. 'target', 'ESR1', 'MKI67').
target.errorMessage: The target column name must be at least 1 character long and cannot be empty.

task.description: Type of machine learning task to perform
task.help_text: Currently only 'classification' is supported for binary classification tasks using MIL architectures.
